hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" | { read -r f || exit 0; app="${f%%/apps/simulateur-eligibilite/*}/apps/simulateur-eligibilite"; case "$f" in "$app"/*.ts|"$app"/*.tsx) out=$(cd "$app" && npx --no-install biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched "$f" 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; }
